title: Customization shortcuts (Agents sidebar)
description: The Customizations section at the bottom of the Agents window's sessions sidebar (`.agent-sessions-customizations-section`): a collapsible "Customizations" header and the shortcut links (Overview, Plugins, MCP Servers, Skills, Instructions, Agents, Hooks, Tools, Extensions) with their counts. Each link opens the Customizations editor on that section. Verified geometry, fonts and colors against the live sidebar; the remaining diff is the color of a `border-style: none` border (`currentcolor`), which isn't painted.
usage: Bottom of the Agents window sessions sidebar (280px wide). Listen for `open-customizations` to open <vsc-customizations-editor> on that section.

attributes.name: active
attributes.description: Section id of the link to highlight (overview, plugins, mcp, skills, instructions, agents, hooks, tools, extensions).

attributes.name: counts
attributes.description: Counts for Plugins, MCP Servers, Skills, Instructions, Agents, Hooks, Tools.

states.name: open
states.trigger: Click a link: fires `open-customizations` with the section (Overview → browse).

states.name: active
states.trigger: `active` highlights the link of the open section (prototype affordance; the product doesn't track it).
